eventSource: host-side cordis events: session/created, session/event, session/disposed, agent/error (no polling)

capabilityNotes.toolUse: tool/call -> tool.start, tool/result -> tool.end|tool.fail; live observed
capabilityNotes.tokenMetrics: assistant/message.usage -> output.end.metadata.tokenCount/contextUsed; live observed. No tokensPerSecond is invented.
capabilityNotes.approval: approval/asked|decided -> approval.request|resolve; implemented, NOT_TESTED live (no approval prompt occurred)
capabilityNotes.outputStream: assistant/chunk text-delta -> output.start/output.chunk/output.end (no text content is sent)

notCovered.thinking: DeepSeek Harness exposes no durable or live 'thinking' state event; the adapter never emits a thinking state (architecture §4 forbids inventing it).
notCovered.tokensPerSecond: not present in SessionEvent payloads; only tokenCount/contextUsed/contextLimit are forwarded, renderer shows '—' for tokens/s.
notCovered.promptContent: deliberately not read or transmitted; user/message contributes only source.kind='user' -> task.received.
notCovered.approvalLive: implemented but no live approval prompt was triggered during verification.
